module: Third-party library lustache (Olivine Labs, MIT license, version 1.3.1-0): Mustache template engine in Lua. This file is the entry point: it creates a renderer and exposes its methods (render, compile, parse, clear_cache) directly on the `lustache` table. The `partials` and `tags` keys can be assigned to define the partials and the delimiters.
notes: Call the methods with a colon (`lustache:render(...)`): the renderer detects and rejects `lustache.render(...)` with a string as the first argument.
The file adds a global function `string.split_lustache(str, sep)` (splits on the characters of `sep` taken as a character class) used by the context and the renderer.
The module is required under the path `common/libs/lustach/src/lustache` (the folder is named `lustach`, without an "e").
Only the `partials` and `tags` keys are writable on the module (via __newindex); other writes are ignored.

renderer.desc: Renderer instance (see lustache/renderer) to which unknown keys are redirected.
